scientific_integrity: Proof and independent exact-rational finite-chain reconstruction supplied; the proof, not computation, supports all finite degrees and the limiting statement.
scientific_limitations: Exact for independent fair redraws and exchangeable leaves with hub copying rate independent of star degree. Unpublished equivalent moment recursions or deductions from older duality formulas remain a priority risk. The general two-state fluid limit is already addressed in prior work and is not itself claimed as new.
title: An exact triangular stationary-law recursion for noisy voters on a star
